title: DevConqueror Universal Panel Keyless
features:
MAIN TAB
INF HP – Toggle to set the player's health and max health to 1,000,000,000.

FLY MODE – Toggle to enable flight.

FLY SPEED – Slider to adjust flying speed (range: 10 – 500).

WALK SPEED – Slider to adjust walking speed (range: 16 – 500).

NOCLIP – Toggle to make the player's character parts non-collidable.

INF JUMP – Toggle to enable infinite jumping.

Joke Button – A yellow button that teleports the player to a specific game (Place ID: 92544971388901).

TELEPORT TAB
ALT + CLICK TP – Toggle to teleport to the mouse hit position when holding Left Alt + left-click.

GIVE TP TOOL – Button that gives a tool in the backpack. Clicking the tool teleports you to the mouse hit position.

AUTO TP TO HUMANoid – Toggle to automatically teleport your character to the nearest humanoid (other NPC/player) at a set height.

TP HEIGHT – Slider to adjust the height offset when auto-teleporting (range: 0 – 50).

AUTO FACE CHARACTER – Toggle to automatically rotate your character to face the nearest humanoid.

AUTO FACE CAMERA – Toggle to automatically rotate the camera to look at the nearest humanoid.

COMBAT TAB
TARGET: Head – Clickable button that cycles through aim parts (Head → HumanoidRootPart → Torso → Left Arm → Right Arm → Left Leg → Right Leg → Humanoid).

AIMLOCK – Toggle to lock the camera onto the selected player's chosen body part.

AIM SMOOTH – Slider to adjust the smoothness of the aimlock (range: 0.01 – 1.0).

HITBOX – Toggle to expand the hitbox of all other players (sets HRP.Size to 15,15,15) and makes it visible.

AUTO CLICK – Toggle to automatically simulate a click (changes Humanoid state to Running) while the left mouse button is held.

CLICK SPEED – Slider to adjust the click interval for Auto Click (range: 0.01 – 1.0 seconds).

VISUAL TAB
PLAYER ESP – Toggle to enable a colored Highlight effect on all other players.

FULL BRIGHT – Toggle to increase Lighting.Brightness to 2 and disable global shadows.

FPS BOOST – Toggle that disables textures/decals (sets transparency to 1), disables particle emitters/trails, and changes part materials to SmoothPlastic to improve performance.

MISC TAB
REJOIN – Button to teleport the player back to the same game (rejoin).

SERVER HOP – Button to teleport to the same game (effectively a server hop, identical to rejoin in this script).

TP TO PLAYER – Button that teleports your character to the currently selected player (from the right-side player list) with a 3-stud offset behind them.

ANTI AFK – Toggle that periodically forces the character to jump and then run to avoid being kicked for inactivity.

AUTO COLLECT – Toggle that automatically teleports your character to nearby collectible items (detects names containing: coin, gem, drop, collect, pickup, token, loot, or objects with TouchTransmitter/ProximityPrompt/ClickDetector).

COLLECT RADIUS – Slider to adjust the search radius for Auto Collect (range: 5 – 100).

3RD PERSON – Toggle to increase the camera zoom distance to 500 (allowing third-person view).

INFO TAB
"DevConqueror Panel" – Title label.

"Discord Server" – Label with a "Copy Discord" button (copies https://discord.gg/ReUKcupgDn to clipboard).

Game 1 Button – Teleports to "Rng Skill Fights Beta" (Place ID: 109479739036928).

Game 2 Button – Teleports to "Escape From Jungle Warriors" (Place ID: 102210905913074).

Game 3 Button – Teleports to "Rng Skill Fights" (Place ID: 92544971388901).

GLOBAL UI FEATURES
Toggle UI: Press the K key to show/hide the entire GUI panel.
